name: Signal Cluster S15: Holiday Awareness (Pre/Post Holiday Effect)
description: Tests: holiday() with days_before/days_after, USFederalHolidayCalendar, include_special_closes, is_null for normal-day filter, where() for holiday-filtered returns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S15: Holiday Awareness
# Tests: holiday(), pre/post holiday effect, calendar filtering
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)

# === PRE-HOLIDAY EFFECT ===
# Ariel (1990): 9-14x normal daily returns on day before holiday
pre_holiday = holiday(days_before=1, days_after=0)
pre_holiday_ret = where(pre_holiday, ret)

# === POST-HOLIDAY MOMENTUM ===
post_holiday = holiday(days_before=0, days_after=1)
post_holiday_ret = where(post_holiday, ret)

# === FULL HOLIDAY WINDOW ===
holiday_window = holiday(days_before=1, days_after=1,
    include_special_closes=True)

# === NORMAL DAY FILTER ===
# Filter out holiday-adjacent bars for clean analysis
normal_day = is_null(holiday_window)
normal_ret = where(normal_day, ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
cards(
    category='Holiday Effect',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Holiday vs Normal Returns', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Pre-Holiday Avg', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Post-Holiday Avg', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Normal Day Avg', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4)
    ])
)((pre_holiday_ret, post_holiday_ret, normal_ret))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Pre-Holiday'
    )
)((pre_holiday_ret, pre_holiday))

xy_lines(
    title='Close with Holiday Windows',
    category='Holiday Effect',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=close)
